phases.objective: Make Staging live certification enforce the canonical environment profile before probing Activation Gateway, classify a healthy old Gateway release as repairable convergence drift instead of integrity corruption, and expose the shared convergence classification without granting apply authority or performing mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: An exact Staging release certifies ready; a healthy Gateway on an older exact SHA remains non-ready but is reported as degraded with convergence.status=reconciliation_required and no automatic apply; a policy bound to the wrong environment is blocked before any Gateway health probe.
steps: Load the canonical environment-convergence registry and the selected Staging Gateway policy.
Validate policy key and public host against the Staging profile before constructing or probing the Gateway endpoint.
Treat a profile mismatch as gateway_environment_profile_current integrity failure and stop before the Gateway network probe.
For a profile-valid reachable Gateway, keep gateway_health_reachable as integrity evidence but evaluate gateway_exact_commit as readiness/convergence evidence.
Classify a healthy old sourceCommit as convergence_drift/release_identity_mismatch with repairability=governed and automatic_apply_allowed=false.
Emit the classification in report.convergence while retaining certification as the final judge and requiring exact Gateway release identity for artifact_set.complete.
Keep all provider, database, migration, Production, ruleset and secret mutation disabled.
assertions: The Staging certification policy must match activation_gateway_staging and activation-dev.mad4b.com before any external Gateway probe.
gateway_environment_profile_current is an integrity failure and manual_non_repairable when false.
gateway_exact_commit is a readiness failure classified as convergence_drift/release_identity_mismatch rather than integrity corruption.
A healthy old Gateway SHA yields degraded certification when readiness is not required and convergence.status=reconciliation_required.
An exact Gateway SHA remains required for artifact_set.complete and release-ready certification.
The convergence handoff never auto-applies and live certification performs no provider or Production mutation.
